items.title: UC Berkeley 发布 FastWan-QAD 量化蒸馏视频模型：RTX 5090 单卡 1.8 秒生成 5 秒 480P
items.summary: UC Berkeley Sky Computing Lab 发布 FastWan-QAD 视频生成模型系列，基于 FastVideo 的量化感知蒸馏（QAD）方案训练。在单张 NVIDIA RTX 5090 上端到端生成 5 秒 480P 视频仅需 1.8 秒，模型、代码与博客已开源。This is an intermediary/self-media lead; trace it to a primary source before treating it as a reported fact.

items.title: Forrester：69% 数字业务决策者已部署 answer engine 可见性方案
items.summary: Forrester 称 69% 数字业务决策者正试点或部署 answer engine 可见性方案，市场从 SEO 转向 AEO。Adobe 推 Brand Visibility 并收购 Semrush，Sitecore 收购 Scrunch，Knotch 的 ACE 在 Think with Google 首发。This is an intermediary/self-media lead; trace it to a primary source before treating it as a reported fact.
